minutes_text:
PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  SPECIAL MEETING
  MINUTES
  March 7, 2019

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was held on Thursday, March 7, 2019,
at 2:01 pm in the City Council Community Room A, 1st Floor

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh, Administration
  Yvonne Horton, City Clerk
  Sgt. Luis Jaramillo, Police Department
  Eddy Ikemefuna, Planning & Building Department

  Staff Present:  Peggy L. Velasquez, Finance Department
  Serena Martinez, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee,
provided the item is within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License
Committee.
Chairman Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the
Permits & License Committee on any item on the Agenda.
Chairman Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Item #1:  Following discussion, Committee Member, Eddy Ikemefuna noted for the
  record that the P&L Committee should consider approval for a car rental
  business only and will provide Finance with a copy of the covenant dated
  February 28, 2019.

  A motion was moved and seconded to APPROVE the business license
  request for The Hertz Corporation; dba: Hertz to operate a car rental
  business at 970 W. Manchester Blvd, subject to payment of annual
  business license and tax fees; Los Angeles County Fire Department field
  inspection; car rental facility in C-3 zone, must comply with all conditions of
  PR-2019-012 and recorded covenant dated February 28, 2019; parking
  and/or advertising vehicles for sale , vehicle repairs and/or maintenance on
  city streets, sidewalks, or alleys is strictly prohibited and violators will be
  towed at owners expense; property owner, tenant and/or applicant shall
  obtain a city issued building permit to repair and/or relocate the broken
  glass door at 308 Hindry Ave. (APN No. 4126-008-005) and remove or
  replace window that was previously moved without a city permit; code
  violations were cited on Code Enforcement Violation Notice dated October
  16, 2017; adhere to all applicable IMC rules and regulations, including
  noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously. (Activity No. 00274217)

There being no further business, the meeting was adjourned at 2:25 p.m.

  Respectfully submitted,
 Permits & License Committee  February 28, 2019
Minutes  Page 2 of 2

  Peggy L. Velasquez, Recording Secretary
